property_summary: For any actor and any sequence of deposits, Put must accumulate: c.Acc(actor).balance after a deposit equals the prior balance plus msg.value; the mutant overwrites the balance so a second deposit loses the first, breaking the rule for some inputs.
change_summary: Replace 'acc.balance += msg.value;' with 'acc.balance = msg.value;' so the balance is overwritten instead of accumulated.
